verdict.rationale: Gusto ships AI features (the Gus assistant and agentic payroll prep), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, the evidence only shows Gusto exposing its own MCP server and Multi-Client MCP for external AI tools to call, which is the server role and does not count toward this story. Nothing documents Gusto connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
